title: Design System: Denise Lo Guercio — Portfolio de Arte

label.purpose: Subtitle, footer colophon, per-piece hover index. The system's only secondary text role.

motion.name: ease-in-out-strong
motion.purpose: Reserved for on-screen movement/morphing, not yet used.

components.name: Gallery Item
components.description: Grid cell holding one grabado; hover reveals a drawn registration-mark icon and a mono index label.
components.css: .ds-gallery-item { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(21,21,19,0.05); } .ds-gallery-image { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), filter 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-gallery-mark { position: absolute; inset: 10px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms ease-out; pointer-events: none; } .ds-reg-mark { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: #c1341c; } .ds-gallery-index { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #f6f7f6; mix-blend-mode: difference; } @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-gallery-item:hover .ds-gallery-image { transform: scale(1.035); filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-gallery-item:hover .ds-gallery-mark { opacity: 1; } }

components.name: Footer Link
components.description: The single Instagram link in the colophon footer.
components.css: .ds-footer-link { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #151513; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #dcdedb; text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: color 150ms ease-out, transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-footer-link:hover { color: #c1341c; text-decoration-color: #c1341c; } .ds-footer-link:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

narrative.overview: The system translates the Swiss International Style poster grid through printmaking's own technical vocabulary: registration crosses, crop marks, and edition numbering become the site's typographic and structural language instead of decorative chrome. Cool unprinted-paper white replaces the warm cream this category defaults to; a single proof-mark red is reserved entirely for interaction.
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper-white ground, near-black ink, one restrained proof-red accent used only on interaction.
Objective grotesque display type (Archivo) paired with a technical mono (JetBrains Mono) for all labels and numbering.
A strict, asymmetric, dense-packed CSS grid rather than free-flowing masonry.
Hairline rules stand in for both dividers and depth; no shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners.
Motion is quiet and precise: staggered fade/rise on entrance, a fast registration-mark hover strike on interaction.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Proof Red appears only in response to interaction. A page with Proof Red visible at rest is a bug.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Label type never precedes a heading as a kicker. It only follows as a subtitle or stands alone.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow anywhere. Separation comes from whitespace and hairlines only.

dos: Do keep Proof Red exclusive to interactive/active states.
Do use JetBrains Mono, uppercase, tracked, for every label/numbering role.
Do keep the gallery grid dense-packed so large/small modules never leave gaps.
Do gate every hover effect behind (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
donts: Don't add a kicker/eyebrow label above any heading.
Don't introduce shadows, gradients, rounded corners, or card chrome.
Don't let the display wordmark exceed 6rem at any breakpoint.
Don't invent per-piece titles, prices, or edition data that were not provided.
